Usage: resecta-data build bloom [OPTIONS]

  Build surnames.bloom + given-names.bloom + gazetteer_manifest.json.

Options:
  --build-dir DIRECTORY    [required]
  --sources-dir DIRECTORY  Directory containing the name-corpus source subdirectories.  [default:
                           src/resecta_data/gazetteers/sources]
  --seed INTEGER           [default: 20260416]
  --build-date TEXT        ISO-8601 UTC timestamp recorded in the manifest. Pinned for determinism.
                           [default: 2026-04-16T00:00:00Z]
  --help                   Show this message and exit.
